purpose: Emphasize that no available method can change a situation.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
どうにも + negative / ならない
Without the key, there is no way to get in.
I am so sleepy I cannot concentrate at all.
Nothing can be done if things stay like this.
formation: どうにも + negative / ならない
restrictions: Conveys helplessness or inability to resolve a problem.
mistake: Keep a negative conclusion; it is not a simple question about how.
